points.description: States the ZOH discretisation formulae before substituting: F = e^{AT} and G = (∫_0^T e^{Aτ} dτ)·B (or equivalent G = A^{-1}(F−I)B). Both F and G formulae must be given. Formulae for Euler or Tustin do not earn this mark.
Correct F = e^{-0.2} = 0.8187 (accept 0.819 or 0.82). Forward Euler value 0.8 does not earn this mark. Unevaluated e^{-0.2} earns no mark here.
Correct G = (1 − e^{-0.2})/2 = 0.0906 (accept 0.0906 or 0.091). Sign-inverted (−0.0906), Euler value 0.1, or unevaluated answer earns no mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks: both formulae stated, F ≈ 0.8187, G ≈ 0.0906. Euler (F=0.8, G=0.1) or Tustin discretisation earns at most 1 mark in total, if clearly labelled. A sign-inverted G with correct formula and F earns 2; leaving G blank with formula and F correct earns 2; correct method with F and G left unevaluated earns 1.
